value.string:
Edit field values on an ERP5 document that already exists - including one you created a moment ago with erp5_create.
 
 Automatically handles complex field types:
 - Relation fields (e.g. field_my_specialise_title): set by title, UID is auto-resolved
 - Date fields: pass an ISO date string (e.g. '2024-03-17'), subfields are auto-expanded
 - Checkbox fields: companion default fields are auto-added
 - List fields: companion default fields are auto-added
 
 Pre-validates that fields exist and are editable before submitting (disable with
 skip_validation=true). That check belongs to this tool alone: skipping it does NOT
 skip ERP5's own validation, its constraints or its workflow guards, which apply
 either way. Field keys must use the 'field_my_xxx' format from the form.
 
 USE THIS WHEN:
 - You need to update one or more fields on a document that exists.
 - You have just created a document with erp5_create and are filling it in.
 - You've already verified fields are editable via erp5_read.
 
 DO NOT USE THIS WHEN:
 - You want to create a new document — use erp5_create instead.
 - You want to change the document's workflow state — use erp5_action instead.
 
 PREREQUISITE: Call erp5_read first to discover field keys and check editability.
 Field keys in the erp5_read response (e.g. 'my_title') become 'field_my_title' in field_values.
